scope: Фільми with rus localization and reviewed online cinema streams
default_origin_evidence: No current public description establishes a foreign-only programming policy; the channel is excluded from the foreign-film verified subset until that evidence is available.

Bollywood.ru.origin_evidence: The channel identity is Indian cinema; its films are produced outside Russia and are offered in Russian localization.

BollywoodHD.ro.origin_evidence: Universal TV describes Bollywood HD as programming from Indian studios, outside Russia.

Cinema.ru.origin_evidence: The current Cinema channel description and schedule present world cinema and international titles.

Dorama.ru.origin_evidence: The channel is dedicated to films and series from South Korea, Japan, China and Taiwan, with Russian voice localization.

Evrokino.ru.origin_evidence: The broadcaster describes Evrokino as a channel of European cinema, with European premieres and films.

FILMBOXPlusOne.pl.origin_evidence: FilmBox describes its programming as international film and television, including Hollywood and world cinema.

FilmBox.nl.origin_evidence: FilmBox describes its programming as international film and television, including Hollywood and world cinema.

FlixSnip.ru.origin_evidence: FlixSnip presents international short films from creators around the world.

Hollywood.ru.origin_evidence: Universal TV describes Hollywood as premium content from MGM, Sony Pictures and Warner Bros.

IndiyskoyeKino.ru.origin_evidence: The channel identity is Indian cinema; this is foreign cinema with Russian localization.

Kino1.ua.origin_evidence: Ukrainian channel exception retained under the repository policy for Ukrainian movie broadcasters.

Kino2.ua.origin_evidence: Ukrainian channel exception retained under the repository policy for Ukrainian movie broadcasters.

KinoHit.ru.origin_evidence: The current channel description calls KinoHit popular foreign cinema and the schedule describes films from Hollywood, Europe and Asia.

SilkWayCinema.kz.origin_evidence: Silk Way Cinema states that most of its film programming is produced in Kazakhstan and by Kazakhfilm; Russian audio is localization, not Russian origin.

SonyTurbo.ru.origin_evidence: Sony Turbo programming is an international action-movie channel built around non-Russian studio titles.

STARTWorld.ru.origin_evidence: START World describes series from France, Belgium, Chile and Turkey; it is retained as foreign programming even when catalog metadata places it under movies.

TV1000RussianKinoGlobal.ru.origin_evidence: The channel identity explicitly says Russian cinema; it is excluded regardless of the global distribution suffix.

ViasatKino.ua.origin_evidence: Viasat describes the channel as world cinema, including Hollywood hits and international titles; the Russian track is localization.

ViasatKinoAction.ua.origin_evidence: Viasat describes the channel as Hollywood and European action cinema.

ViasatKinoComedy.ua.origin_evidence: The current Viasat schedule is built around international comedy films.

ViasatKinoWorld.ua.origin_evidence: Viasat identifies this as Ukrainian and world cinema; it is retained as a Ukrainian/world exception with Russian localization.

VelvetEuropeanMovies.ru.origin_evidence: The channel identity explicitly limits the catalogue to European movies.

vijuPlusMegahit.ru.origin_evidence: viju describes Megahit as world masterpieces, international blockbusters and Oscar-winning cinema.

vijuTV1000.ru.origin_evidence: viju states that TV1000 is built around foreign hits and current international titles.

vijuTV1000action.ru.origin_evidence: viju describes TV1000 Action as Hollywood and world action cinema.

Domkino.ru.origin_evidence: Dom Kino describes a library of domestic Russian films and Russian cinema.

DomkinoPremium.ru.origin_evidence: Dom Kino Premium belongs to the Dom Kino domestic Russian cinema brand.

IllusionPlus.ru.origin_evidence: Russian Illusion describes its programming as modern Russian cinema.

MosfilmGoldCollection.ru.origin_evidence: Mosfilm Gold Collection is based on Soviet and Russian classics from Mosfilm.

NasheLubimoeKino.ru.origin_evidence: The channel brand does not establish foreign-only programming; no current public evidence separates foreign films from domestic repertoire.

NasheLubimoeKinoUkraine.ua.origin_evidence: The Ukraine-labelled feed is still the Nashe Lubimoe Kino brand and does not establish a foreign-only catalogue.

NasheNovoeKino.ru.origin_evidence: Nastroy Kino describes the channel as modern Russian cinema and domestic films.

RodnoeKino.ru.origin_evidence: Nastroy Kino describes Rodnoe Kino as Soviet and Russian box-office leaders.

RusskiyBestseller.ru.origin_evidence: The channel is explicitly focused on contemporary Russian series and Russian actors/directors.

RusskiyDetektiv.ru.origin_evidence: The Russian Detective brand is a domestic Russian genre channel; no foreign-only policy is stated.

RusskiyIllusion.ru.origin_evidence: Russian Illusion is a Russian cinema brand and is excluded from the foreign-film subset.

Russkiyroman.ru.origin_evidence: The published program is built around Russian domestic TV films and melodramas.

SovetskoeKino.ru.origin_evidence: The channel identity explicitly denotes Soviet cinema, which belongs to the Russian/Soviet domestic catalogue requested for removal.

STARTAir.ru.origin_evidence: START describes START Air as carrying original START projects; current listings are Russian productions.

StarCinema.ru.origin_evidence: Current channel descriptions identify Star Cinema as based on domestic production from Star Media.

TV21.ru.origin_evidence: TV 21 says it shows world cinema but its current description includes both foreign and Russian films; mixed schedules cannot satisfy the foreign-only rule.

TV21International.ru.origin_evidence: TV 21 International uses the same mixed world and Russian film catalogue; no foreign-only schedule is established.

Kino1.ru.origin_evidence: Kino 1 International is described with Soviet/Russian and CIS premieres, so it is not foreign-only.

Kino1International.ru.origin_evidence: Kino 1 International is described with Soviet/Russian and CIS premieres, so it is not foreign-only.

Kinomix.ru.origin_evidence: Nastroy Kino describes Kinomix as a mix of foreign and Russian cinema; mixed schedules are excluded.

Kinopremyera.ru.origin_evidence: Nastroy Kino listings include both foreign and Russian premieres, so the channel cannot guarantee foreign-only content.

vijuPlusPremiere.ru.origin_evidence: The current viju+ Premiere schedule includes Russian productions alongside international premieres; it is excluded as mixed.

vijuTV1000russkoe.ru.origin_evidence: viju explicitly describes TV1000 Russian as films and series made in Russia.
